scope.selection: owner-selected registered pilot and its direct children
scope.followup_selection: existing registered CS01 gap roots and verified direct children only

paging_scope: bounded gap-root queries; capped groups refined until selected subset exhausted; global population not claimed
semantic_limits: Do not infer system/equipment/component role from boolean flags, ID prefixes or Excel.
Do not parse hierarchypath as a canonical path solely from its name.
Source change time is distinct from retrieval time and ingestion freshness.
evidence_custody: private owner-controlled receipt; no credentials/cookies/tokens persisted
write_scope: new technical Equipment/AssetMaster only, normal existing writers; initial status history and explicitly partial run
followup_remaining_gap_set_check: all remaining gaps are in the queried/exhausted initial subset; no pending root or capped group
unit_filter_limit: eq11=CS01 applies to returned child row; different/missing child unit can be excluded; actual cause UNKNOWN

read_only_unit_exception.authorization: specific owner-approved finite parent allowlist; BSR/IP without child eq11 predicate; no routine-policy change
read_only_unit_exception.coverage: selected parent queries and source-advertised pages exhausted; no global or transactional completeness claim
read_only_unit_exception.paired_CS01_result: no returned children for same selected parents
read_only_unit_exception.field_selection_control: CS01 visible on selected parents; eq11 absent on observed child samples under reduced projection

closed_child_canonical_ingestion.authorization: later explicit owner approval; distinct from preceding read-only exception
closed_child_canonical_ingestion.scope: sealed child allowlist with verified direct parents and BSR/IP; no default-policy expansion
closed_child_canonical_ingestion.source_projection: existing canonical mxasset field selection via mxapiasset
closed_child_canonical_ingestion.writer: existing MartWriter; same-connection outer transaction and savepoint; new asset_master rows only
